searchLog: 9th consecutive day (Aug 5-13) of total WebFetch egress block in this environment, re-confirmed today. WebFetch against www.anthropic.com and api.ashbyhq.com both returned {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED","message":"Access to <domain> is blocked by the network egress proxy."}. This is confirmed to be the environment's own network-access policy (not the CCR HTTPS_PROXY layer, which is a separate, working, unrelated tunnel used for git/npm/etc) -- it is a session-level egress allowlist that must be changed in this environment's network policy settings on claude.ai/code, not something fixable from inside a run. WebSearch still works and surfaced what looks like a live, on-profile lead -- Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)', opened 2026-07-16, matching target-companies.json's note exactly and role family #4 (APM) in profile.md -- but per the honesty rules a search snippet cannot confirm eligibility/openness/cost, which requires loading the real page. That remains impossible from inside this run, so it is correctly omitted rather than included on secondhand evidence. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output under these conditions. This is now a 9-day unresolved pattern needing a fix at the environment network-policy level (allowlist career-page domains: greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, workable.com, anthropic.com/careers, metacareers.com, etc.) -- it cannot be worked around from inside a run.
